title: The parol, five ways: Filipino Christmas lanterns worth hanging
dek: From glowing Pampanga capiz stars to handmade abaca lanterns and a tiny parol for the tree, five kinds of parol and the safety checks to make before you plug one in.
teaser: Capiz, abaca and LED: five kinds of parol and the safety checks that matter.
description: The best Filipino parols to buy online in 2026: capiz star and Pampanga lanterns, handmade abaca parols, a mini parol ornament and a certified LED parol, with safety tips.

hero.alt: AI sample render of a condo wall at night with glowing parols: a colourful capiz star, a round capiz lantern, two natural abaca parols with tails, a small cream star ornament and a multicolour LED parol
hero.caption: AI sample render of our five picks, drawn from written descriptions of each product. The real product photos from Lazada are below.

intro: Nothing says Pinoy Christmas quite like a parol in the window. It is the lantern we grew up making in school, the glow that tells the whole street the season has started, and one of the most beautiful crafts we have.
Parols now come in every material and budget, so we picked one strong example of each kind you can buy online, and we put safety first, because most capiz parols plug into the wall.

curation.title: One great parol of each kind
summary: A parol is the Filipino Christmas lantern, most often a five-pointed star with two tails. Lantern makers in San Fernando, Pampanga turned the bamboo-and-paper original into capiz, fabric and LED designs, so today there is a parol for every wall and budget.
We scored each parol on craft and material, the maker, safety (no cord, or a visible PS or ICC mark) and fair price. Real capiz and natural fibre ranked above plastic.
steps: Read parol craft sources, from the Pampanga lantern makers to DTI and Meralco safety guidance.
Listed the kinds worth owning: capiz star, round Pampanga lantern, handmade abaca, a mini ornament and an LED parol.
Compared Lazada listings for each kind, favouring named Filipino makers and checking every photo.
Flagged every plug-in parol without a visible safety mark, and dropped listings whose details did not add up.

callouts.title: Before you buy a plug-in parol
callouts.body: Most capiz parols are made by small workshops and plug into the wall. DTI says covered lighting products must carry a PS mark or an ICC sticker before they are sold. None of the capiz parols below showed one in their listing photos, so ask the seller for a photo of the mark on the lights or box before you check out. If they can't show it, choose one of the cordless abaca parols instead.

sources.name: DTI Bureau of Philippine Standards: PS and ICC Marks

callouts.title: Use it safely every night
callouts.body: Hang parols on a sturdy hook away from curtains, never plug several into one socket (no octopus connections), and switch them off before bed or before leaving home. Capiz becomes brittle over time, so wrap each one in cloth when you pack it away.

items.label: Best capiz
items.name: JSC Special Capiz Parol, 18 in (LED)
items.verdict: The classic Pampanga capiz star: real shell panes glowing in bold colours, from a shop named for Pampanga capiz parols.
items.summary: Capiz is a thin, translucent shell, so light comes through it soft and jewel-toned. This 18-inch star layers red, green, blue and yellow capiz petals around a red centre, outlined in LEDs. It comes in 220V for home, or 110V for family abroad.

reviewers.point: Parols were traditionally made of bamboo and Japanese paper; modern ones also use plastic, metal and capiz shell.
Capiz is the shell of the windowpane oyster. It has long been used as a glass substitute because it is durable and lets light through.
Meralco advises using only Christmas lights with a PS mark or ICC sticker, and unplugging lights and lanterns before bed or when leaving home.
reviewers.source: Interaksyon (Philstar): Meralco holiday electrical safety tips (23 Dec 2022)

pros: Real capiz shell panes in a classic star shape
From a store named for Pampanga capiz parols
220V for home, or 110V to send abroad
cons: PS mark or ICC sticker not shown; ask the seller first
Plug-in, so hang it near an outlet
items.bestFor: The main parol of the house, on a sala wall or inside a big window
items.tip: Before checkout, ask the seller for a photo of the PS mark or ICC sticker on the lights. Choose 220V, use a sturdy hook and unplug it at bedtime.

alt.name: Capiz Poinsettia Parol, 20 in
alt.label: Also beautiful
alt.note: A round capiz lantern with a red-and-green poinsettia centre. It is plug-in too, with no PS mark or ICC sticker visible in the photo and few store details, so ask the seller for a photo of the mark before buying.

items.slot: A parol for the window or door
items.label: Best Pinoy touch
items.name: Localimade Abaca Parols with Tails, Set of 2 (8 x 11 in)
items.verdict: A pair of handmade abaca parols in red and green: the Filipino Christmas symbol, with no cord and no floor space.
items.summary: Condo guides suggest a parol on the wall instead of more on the floor. These handmade abaca parols have the classic crescent, star and tails, and need no power. Hang the red one in front of the curtain lights so it glows, and the green one on the door.

reviewers.point: Federal Land suggests decorating the walls to save floor space, including installing a parol on a wall.
reviewers.source: Federal Land Knowledge Hub: 11 Christmas Decoration Ideas for Condo Spaces (Dec 2021)

reviewers.point: The parol is 'an iconic symbol of Filipino Christmas', and its most common form is a five-pointed star with two tails.
Abaca is a banana species native to the Philippines, and its fibre is woven into handicrafts.

pros: Handmade abaca: natural fibre, not plastic
No cord, so it hangs anywhere
Two parols per order, in palette colours
cons: Unlit, so pair it with fairy or curtain lights
Compact (8 x 11 in), sized for windows and doors
items.bestFor: The window (in front of the curtain lights) and the inside of the unit door
items.tip: Choose red and green to match the set. Hang them with clear thread from adhesive hooks, and keep them away from the stove and hot bulbs.

items.label: Best Pampanga showpiece
items.name: Tori's Capiz 'Dayang Dayang' Parol, 20 in (all LED)
items.verdict: A big round capiz lantern in the San Fernando style, from a named capiz shop, with flower-painted panes that look festive even unlit.
items.summary: Large round, patterned parols are the San Fernando signature, known as 'parul sampernandu'. This 20-inch disc has tinted capiz panes painted with pink flowers and red, navy and violet petals, ringed with LED lights. It's a showpiece for a wall of its own.

reviewers.point: Large disc-shaped electronic parols from Pampanga are called 'parul sampernandu', a spelling of 'parol San Fernando'.
A San Fernando lantern maker quoted in 2022 priced capiz lanterns for homes at about ₱1,800 to ₱2,500, depending on design and size.
reviewers.source: Create Philippines: The craft and tradition of parul lives on (Tricia Quintero, 11 Jan 2022, via Rappler)

reviewers.point: The BFP says to buy only Christmas lights with PS and ICC marks, and to switch lights off in the wee hours when everyone is asleep.
reviewers.source: GMA News: BFP tips for a fire-free holiday (4 Dec 2025)

pros: Real tinted capiz panes, in the Pampanga disc style
From a named capiz handicraft store
20 in: a true showpiece for one wall
cons: PS mark or ICC sticker not shown; ask the seller first
Bold pink and violet tones make a statement
items.bestFor: A plain sala or dining wall that can take one big statement piece
items.tip: Give it a bare wall so the pattern reads from across the room. Ask the seller for PS/ICC proof first, and unplug it before bed.

items.label: Best local handicraft
items.name: Mairenuel Handicrafts Native Christmas Star Ornament (cream)
items.verdict: A soft cream star from a local handicraft seller, frosted at the tips like a snowy bottle-brush tree.
items.summary: It brings handmade texture to a white scheme for about the price of a snack, and the listing offers several colours, so choose cream or white. Hang one on the tree, or several down a ribbon in the window.

reviewers.point: A Sherwin-Williams colour manager quoted by Homes & Gardens notes a shift toward softer, more tactile holiday decor, and the article names cream, white and beige as ideal for a minimalist Christmas.
reviewers.source: Homes & Gardens: Christmas color schemes, 9 seasonal palettes (Zara Stacey, updated 29 Oct 2024)

reviewers.point: Interior designer Irene Gunter, quoted by Livingetc, has used hand-painted decorations inherited from her parents for years; handmade pieces become keepsakes.
reviewers.source: Livingetc: Christmas tree ideas, design experts on how to decorate like a pro (Amy Neason, updated 28 Oct 2022)

pros: Soft texture adds depth to all-white decor
Several colours, so it can join other themes
cons: Check the size in the listing photos
Natural fibre: handle gently to keep it neat
items.bestFor: Adding handmade texture to a white tree or window
items.tip: Choose cream. Hang three at different heights from a thin white ribbon on a curtain rod for a simple window display.

items.label: Best budget LED
items.name: NAJIA LED Parol Wall Light (multicolour)
items.verdict: The budget LED parol, from a branded store whose photo shows a BPS product-safety mark with a license number.
items.summary: LED parols are light, affordable and bright, so most homes have one. This NAJIA wall parol comes from the brand's own store, and its photo shows a Bureau of Philippine Standards 'Certified Product Safety' mark with a license number. Expect bold, moving colour.

reviewers.point: Pampanga makers pioneered electric parols with rotor systems; a 1957 rotor design by lantern-maker Rodolfo David became the template for commercial electric parols.
DTI says the PS mark and ICC sticker are the buyer's assurance of certified quality and safety, and ICC stickers can be checked with the ICC Verification Mobile App.
reviewers.source: DTI Bureau of Philippine Standards: PS and ICC Marks

reviewers.point: Meralco says to avoid 'octopus' connections and to unplug Christmas lights and lanterns before going to bed or leaving home.
reviewers.source: Interaksyon (Philstar): Meralco holiday electrical safety tips (23 Dec 2022)

pros: BPS product-safety mark shown in the photo
The lowest-priced lit parol in this guide
cons: Plastic body with lively multicolour light modes
Check the PS mark on the actual box when it arrives
items.bestFor: A bright, budget parol for a wall, a gate or a window
items.tip: When it arrives, find the PS mark on the product or box. Plug it into its own socket, no octopus wiring, and unplug it before bed.
